text: The doctor analyzed my symptoms in great detail and prescribed the right medication for my symptoms. The price was not expensive. For just a few hundred baht, you can see a psychiatrist without having to wait in long lines.

restaurant_name: คลินิกหมอบุญกุล
text: This was a very disappointing experience. The doctor was not compassionate and refused to provide the support I needed, despite me explaining my situation and condition. There was no individualized care, and my needs were dismissed outright. It was a very distressing experience. Doctors should approach each patient with empathy and a willingness to understand their individual needs. I would never return.
